verdicts.reason: The two layouts are nearly identical, and both share the same flaws. The suitcase almost touches the left edge and has lost its circle backdrop. The Meridian logo has dropped to the bottom-left corner under the suitcase, so the brand comes last instead of leading. The legal text is crammed into a block of about 4px type that nobody can read. The headline and subcopy also run almost to the right edge. A is slightly better because its 'How It Works' button is a little larger and more prominent. B's text column starts further left and its button is smaller, which makes the right column feel more cramped.
